evidence: Figure 1: Conceptual overview of reconfigurable skill policy under sparse governing information . (left) Sparse task evidence specifies desired changes, while procedure-side evidence provides task-agnostic skill records observed through multiple procedure views. (middle) Behavior retrieval accesses stored records independently, whereas structured procedural approaches expose connectivity among reusable behaviors. (right) RecPo converts observed view-level changes into a compositional query and materializes a task-specific executable skill sequence over view-consistent procedural transitions.
